description: The graph illustrates the loss evolution during training for different models across iterations, with the x-axis representing the number of iterations (#Iteration) on a linear scale ranging from 95,000 to 125,000, and the y-axis showing the loss value on a linear scale from 2.0 to 3.0. Four distinct lines are plotted: a pink dashed line labeled "SepLLM (n=64, larger lr)" starts at a loss of approximately 3.0 and decreases rapidly, leveling off around 2.3 by 125,000 iterations; a blue solid line labeled "SepLLM (n=128)" begins at a loss of about 3.0 and also decreases sharply, stabilizing near 2.3 by the end; an orange solid line labeled "SepLLM (n=64)" follows a similar trend, starting at 3.0 and converging to a loss of approximately 2.3; and a red dashed line labeled "Vanilla before post-training" remains relatively flat, staying constant at a loss of about 2.35 across all iterations. All models exhibit a general downward trend in loss, with SepLLM variants showing significant initial improvement.
